dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: We have one less key than Adelinde... uh-huh...

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: *gasp* Does that mean... There's a secret room!?

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: And so this one time, when I was waxing the floors, I noticed that right down the far end of the corridor on the second floor... there's a hidden room!

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Really!? So that's really the room that...?

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Well. I crept up to the door and as I got close, I heard this "thud... thud... thud" sound getting closer and closer!

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: I was like, sooo scared... and then just as I was about to run away... Adelinde was behind me!

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: The weirdest thing is that she didn't even tell me off. Instead, she was all polite and asked me nicely to go back to my room...

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: But when I got back to my room, that's when I realized—

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: That thudding sound... it was exactly like how Adelinde's shoes sound when she walks!
